provenance.note: A dark detuned noise-saw stab: the struck supersaw's seven saws close together, a filter falling from seven times its 650 Hz corner in a tenth of a second, resonant, driven, crushed at six bits and breathing noise; its edge never an octave (octaveMix nought).

notes.octaveMix: Nought: the edge is the drive and the noise, never a saw an octave over.
notes.timbres: none declared: a sketch row, held at nought (AWAITING) until his pick admits it
notes.hpHz: 300 Hz (round dark-fronts' fourth pass): clear of the low-mids the reese and the formant pad fill (150-600 Hz), so it stands in front by its band and not by its level.
